note: Adds BatchPartition::record, which restarts the ledger charge slice when the generation moves mid-batch, with unit tests for the mid-batch regain case.
Moves REQUIRED_SLACK_SCOPES and bot_is_ready into a new posthog/helpers/slack_scopes.py module and imports them from there.
Replaces the direct ai_observability import in the export task with a format-to-handler lookup in the exports facade, registered from the product's apps.py.
Drops the malformed_leaves map, adds malformed_leaf_count to CohortParseFlags, and freeze_with iterates flags filtering on a non-zero count.
Replaces the inline node-type branching with a shared node_type_for helper from saved_query_dag_sync, used by both code paths.
Renames the replaying field and is_replaying method to redelivering/is_redelivering and updates related comments; adds a double-failure test.
Adds table validation errors and a disabled state to the trigger UI, skips person lookup for warehouse rows; no forced exit condition or serializer change.
Removes the handrolled session_reset, dialog_expired and state_snapshot event types, leaving only UI requests and SDK-typed extension errors; moves extension handling to its own controller.
Returns the body library from parse_and_authenticate as a fourth tuple element and uses it instead of calling stamp_body_sdk_info again.
Switches the guard field from the primary key to a table access_control_id; still inlines blocked IDs as an AST constant rather than bound parameters.
